raw_ocr_text:
All that certain lot or parcel of land and premises, situate in the Borough of Haddonfield and County of Camden and State of New Jersey, known and described as follows:

BEGINNING at a point in the Westerly line of Birchall Drive distant 486.81 feet from the Northerly line of Kings Highway, said point being the Westerly line of Birchall Drive with the Northerly line of Kings Highway, said connecting curve having a radius of 75 feet, thence
(1) Northerly along the Westerly line of Birchall Drive 94.10 feet to a point in the division line between Lots 6 and 7, thence
(2) Westerly along said division line at right angles to Birchall Drive 112.74 feet to a point in the Westerly boundary line of said plan, thence
(3) Southerly along said boundary line at another right angle 89 degrees 52 minutes with the last course the distance of 90 feet to a point, thence
(4) Easterly [ILLEGIBLE] an interior angle of 90 degrees 08 minutes with the last course and at right angles to Birchall Drive 112.52 feet to the place of BEGINNING.

Being part of Lot 6, on Plan of County Club Estates, made by Walter H. Macmoran, C.E., dated December 1950, revised January 4, 1957.

ALSO BEING KNOWN as Block 91.1, Lot 32 on the Tax Map of the Borough of Haddonfield.

BEING KNOWN AS 32 Birchall Drive, Haddonfield, New Jersey
